title: How to Make a Jelly Roll Rug | A Shabby Fabrics Sewing Tutorial
description:
We're always looking for projects that we can complete using precuts like Jelly Rolls, and this one is so cute and so fun we had to share it with you! We love that this project is both pretty and practical, and we've gotten permission from Roma, the pattern designer, to share a part of the process with you. 

You'll need 40 of these 2.5 inch by width of fabric strips to make this 30" x 42" Rug, and 50 yards of 2.5" batting. The pattern covers how to make other shapes, and you can increase the size of the rug simply by using more strips.  

We used the Bernina #97D foot to create the strips. We used the Bernina #20 foot to zig-zag the strips together. We did not use a walking foot while assembling the rug. 

* NOTE: In this video, Jen says the batting rolls measure 50 yards and that you'll need 2. The rolls she used actually measure 25 yards, so she needed 2.

We recommend sewing your rug with a heavy-duty needle, like a denim needle, that will be able to handle the bulk of the strips. You can find our suggestions in the list below. 

For more information: https://www.shabbyfabrics.com/free-downloads-and-video/85/how-to-make-a-jelly-roll-rug
_____________________________________________________________ 

*WHAT YOU'LL NEED FOR THIS TUTORIAL*

*Option 1*
Use a Jelly Roll Rug kit that we've already chosen and assembled for you!

Jelly Roll Kits: https://www.shabbyfabrics.com/search?sortOrder=6&q=Jelly+Roll+Rug+Kit

*Option 2*
Or, assemble your own kit in 3 parts!

1. ) 1 Jelly Roll Rug Pattern: https://www.shabbyfabrics.com/p65931/jelly-roll-rug-pattern

2.) 40 fabric strips measuring 2.5 inches by width of fabric (approximately 1 standard size Jelly Roll) of your choice: https://www.shabbyfabrics.com/c87/fabrics/precuts/jelly-rolls

3.) 50 yards of Katahdin Batting Strips: https://www.shabbyfabrics.com/search?sortOrder=6&q=Katahdin+Batting
